[P2] Return to design for the new logging feature

Rule 3, “Write a design note before the code,” applies to new features independently of public API changes. Adding a job counter and a documented log field is a new feature, but the description explicitly declares its design note unnecessary because no public API changes. This bypasses the required design agreement. Following rules 8 and 9, return to the design phase: document the problem, cause, simpler alternatives, chosen approach, and removals, and obtain maintainer agreement before continuing.
